prompt/acres_range.text: Acres must be between a quarter and 200. Please say again.

prompt/acres_unknown.text: I did not get the acres. Say, for example, 5 acres.

prompt/ask_acres.text: How many acres need the machine? For example 5 acres or 3 and a half acres.

prompt/ask_consent.text: Your number and field details are used only for the machine turn and the work record. Shall we confirm the booking?

prompt/ask_date.text: When was or when will the paddy be harvested? For example today, tomorrow or 15 November. If you don't know, say 'don't know'.

prompt/ask_machine.text: Which machine do you need? Super Seeder, Happy Seeder, Baler or Mulcher?

prompt/ask_phone.text: Please tell me your 10-digit mobile number.

prompt/ask_village.text: Which village is your field in? Say the village name.

prompt/booking_cancelled.text: Okay, nothing was booked. Pick any step above to change it.

prompt/date_range.text: That date is too far. Give a date within two months.

prompt/date_unknown.text: I did not get the date. Say today, tomorrow or 15 November.

prompt/done_needs_info.text: Your request is saved. The turn is fixed once the harvest date is known. Thank you.

prompt/done_open.text: Your request is saved. The centre will tell you when your turn is fixed. Thank you.

prompt/done_sched_pre.text: Your turn is booked. The machine will come to your field on

prompt/done_will_miss.text: Your request is saved, but no machine is free in time yet. The centre will call you soon.

prompt/machine_unknown.text: I did not get the machine. Say Super Seeder, Happy Seeder, Baler or Mulcher.

prompt/mic_off.text: The mic is off. You can type your answer below.

prompt/no_speech.text: I heard nothing. Tap the mic and speak again.

prompt/phone_continue.text: Okay. Now say the remaining digits.

prompt/phone_long.text: That has more than ten digits. Say just the ten digits again.

prompt/phone_short.text: The number is incomplete. Say all ten digits slowly.

prompt/phone_start.text: A mobile number starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9. Say it again.

prompt/retry_generic.text: Sorry, I did not get that. Please say it again.

prompt/submit_failed.text: Sorry, the booking was not saved. Try again or talk to the centre.

prompt/village_unknown.text: That village is not on the list. Say it again or pick from the list below.

prompt/welcome.text: Sat Sri Akal! Welcome to Vaari. Five quick questions and your machine turn is booked.
